Geometry_and_Silhouette: Building with transparent glass or polycarbonate walls and roof.
Roof is pitched (gable or lean-to) or curved (hoop house).
Dimensions vary: small (2x3 m) to commercial (10x50+ m).
Functional_Components: Glazing panels are rectangular glass panes or twin-wall polycarbonate sheets, creating grid pattern.
Ventilation: roof vents, side windows, or exhaust fans.
Door is full-height with handle.
Material_and_Context: Frame is aluminum (silver, extruded profiles), steel (painted green or galvanized), or wood (cedar, redwood).
Interior shows shelving, benches, and plant arrangements.
Condensation visible on interior glass surface.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Automotive front grating within rectangular frame.
Slats are parallel bars (5-15 mm wide) with uniform spacing, or mesh pattern (honeycomb, diamond).
Depth is 5-15 cm from bumper face.
Functional_Components: Horizontal or vertical slats admitting cooling air to radiator.
Emblem or badge centered on grille surface.
Airflow gaps between slats reveal radiator fins behind.
Material_and_Context: Chrome, black plastic, or painted metal construction.
Surface texture is polished chrome (reflective), matte black, or textured plastic.
Frame surrounds grille with body-colored or chrome border.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Retail marketplace with large storefront and display windows.
Facade features prominent signage with store name and logo.
Exterior shows parking lot, cart corrals, and automatic sliding doors.
Functional_Components: Interior visible through glass: aisles of shelving stocked with packaged goods.
Produce section with colorful fruits and vegetables, refrigerated cases along walls.
Checkout counters at front with conveyor belts and cash registers.
Material_and_Context: Fluorescent lighting illuminates interior.
Floor is tile or polished concrete.
Color palette is bright with promotional signage. Shopping carts and baskets near entrance.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Tall vertical frame (3-4 meters) constructed from wooden posts and crossbeam.
Two vertical posts (square timber, 15-20 cm) support angled blade channel.
Overall structure is imposing, with blade visible in raised position.
Functional_Components: Blade is heavy triangular steel (weighted, sharp lower edge) suspended by rope and pulley.
Release mechanism (trigger/latch) at top.
Basket or trough at base to receive severed head.
Material_and_Context: Wood surface is unfinished or weathered, showing grain and construction joints.
Metal components (blade, hardware) are dark iron or steel.
Proportions: tall narrow frame with horizontal crossbeam.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Decorative hinged hair clip, 5-15 cm long.
Shape is barrette (elongated oval), bow, flower, or geometric.
Hinged clasp opens to reveal toothed or smooth gripping surface.
Functional_Components: Spring-loaded mechanism concealed within body.
Grip teeth are fine metal ridges on inner surface.
Decorative elements face outward when worn.
Material_and_Context: Metal (gold-tone, silver-tone, or colored enamel) with decorative surface (jewels, pearls, filigree, or engraved pattern).
Surface finish is polished metal, enameled color, or encrusted with rhinestones/crystals.
Spring mechanism is concealed within body.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Aerosol can, cylindrical metal container, height 20-30 cm, diameter 5-7 cm.
Cap is dome-shaped or flat, removable.
Overall form is standard aerosol cylinder with ergonomic grip.
Functional_Components: Spray nozzle (actuator) on top with fine mist aperture.
Label shows hold strength indicator (light, medium, firm, extra firm) and ingredients.
Bottom shows crimped seam and manufacturing codes.
Material_and_Context: Surface is printed with brand name, product type, and graphics in vibrant colors.
Can surface is smooth with glossy printed graphics.
Contains hair-holding preparation.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Military vehicle with front wheels and rear continuous tracks.
Length 5-6 meters, width 2 meters.
Overall hybrid appearance combines truck front with tank-like rear.
Functional_Components: Front: conventional truck cab with windshield, hood, and steering wheels.
Rear: tracked propulsion system with rubber or steel tracks wrapping around road wheels.
Cargo area has drop-down sides and tailgate.
Material_and_Context: Color is military olive drab, tan, or camouflage pattern.
Tracks show individual track links and road wheel arrangement.
Cab features military-style flat fenders and headlight guards.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Hand tool with heavy metal head and handle, length 25-35 cm.
Head is forged steel with striking face (flat, circular, 2-4 cm diameter).
Claw curves downward with split fork, or ball-peen (rounded opposite face).
Functional_Components: Striking face shows slight crown.
Handle attaches through eye (hole) in head, secured by wedge.
Claw (curved fork for nail extraction) or ball-peen opposite face.
Material_and_Context: Head is forged steel (polished or painted).
Handle is wood (hickory, ash) with smooth grain, fiberglass (textured grip), or steel (rubber grip).
Head weight 200-500 grams. Surface texture: smooth metal head, grippy handle.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Basket container with hinged or removable lid.
Shape is rectangular or oval with vertical sides.
Dimensions: 40-60 cm tall, 30-40 cm wide.
Functional_Components: Lid is domed or flat, hinged on one side or fully removable.
Handles are integrated (woven loops) or attached (leather straps, rope).
Interior may have fabric lining (white cotton).
Material_and_Context: Wicker (natural rattan, brown, woven pattern), willow (light tan, tight weave), or fabric (canvas, collapsible).
Woven texture shows over-under pattern with visible reed strands.
Color is natural tan, stained brown, or painted white.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Handheld electric hair styling device, length 20-25 cm.
Body is pistol-grip or T-shaped plastic housing.
Nozzle is circular or concentrator attachment (narrow slit).
Functional_Components: Rear intake grille (circular mesh pattern) reveals fan blades inside.
Heat/speed control switches on handle or body.
Power cord extends from base (2-3 m). Cool-shot button may be present.
Material_and_Context: Plastic housing (black, white, pink, or metallic).
Surface is smooth plastic with matte or glossy finish.
Weight is light (300-500 grams). Airflow direction is from rear intake to front nozzle.
